notes: Meets 1st and 3rd Wednesdays, 6:00 to 7:30 pm at the Central Library.
name: Teen Library Board
what_you_do: Plan and run a library program for teens, meet library leaders, explore careers and give feedback on teen services.
who_can_apply: Teens who live in Baltimore City and are in grades 9 to 12, and can attend the meetings.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Earns service learning hours. Dinner is provided at meetings.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications closed. Members are told by October 16, 2026. The page says to check back in the spring for 2027-28 applications.
how_to_apply: Application on the Pratt Library page when it opens in spring. Not open now.
